inquiry.subject: Rust on a new chipper
inquiry.body: Hey, just unboxed my new FH-340 and there is paint flaking off the hopper and a few rust spots on the frame already. Looks like it sat somewhere damp. I'm still happy to keep it if there's something you can do, just wanted to flag it and see what my options are. Thanks!

retrieved.title: Returns and Damaged-on-Arrival Policy for Customers
retrieved.heading: Return window
retrieved.text: You may ask to return a new, unused machine within 30 days of delivery. The machine must be in its original box and in its original condition. Used machines go through the warranty process instead.

retrieved.title: Replacement Parts Process
retrieved.heading: Is the part covered?
retrieved.text: Customer care or the Quality team confirms if a part is covered before it ships. A part may be covered when it is missing from a new machine or when it failed from a defect. A worn part, such as a dull blade, is usually a wear part and is not a defect. A Fernhollow staff member reviews each request and decides. Do not assume a part is free until staff confirm it in writing.

retrieved.title: Safety Escalation Rule
retrieved.heading: What counts as a safety case
retrieved.text:
Any report of one of these is a safety case:
- fire
- smoke
- burns
- a fuel leak
- electric shock
- parts thrown from a machine
- injury
This applies to every Fernhollow machine: the FH-210 log splitter, the FH-340 wood chipper, the FH-520 stump grinder, the FH-P90 pressure washer, and the FH-G7 generator. It applies if the report comes from a customer, a dealer, or a distributor.
